Decode payload first. Split on ASCII spaces retaining empty fields. Independently transform consecutive groups of 16 fields (last may be shorter). Compare fields lexicographically by Unicode code points, shorter prefixes first; empty is smallest. Repeatedly remove the last field x and save it. If fields remain, let low mean the first remaining field is <= x. Split BEFORE every field whose comparison <= x equals low; rotate the first field of each block to its end. Continue; reverse the saved fields to get the output. Join all output fields with ASCII spaces, preserving every other character; print only.
